limitations: Two selected historical initial payments from the same acquirer, not a representative current Tok average or an available assignable option.
The reference excludes fees, scholarships, exploration work, recurring payments, royalties and other obligations; it is not full contract capital.
Northway also involved a separate USD 25,000 scholarship and USD 400,000 first-year exploration obligation. These are not included in the initial-payment statistic.
Comparison areas A and B are sample partitions, not legal parcels. No observed assignment resale price or margin is supplied.
Use of the historical payment as a hypothetical option premium does not verify equivalent rights, assignment permission, term or current value.

syntheticLotProfile.assumption: One synthetic whole-contract interest retains the invented reference unit economics by scaling both quantity and remaining buyer consideration. The scale is frozen; editing the premium does not change exposure or assignment value.
limitations: The reference unit and its premium-to-exposure ratio are invented arithmetic assumptions, not evidence of mispricing, resources, fair value or attainable returns.
The historical USD 30,000 initial-payment reference does not establish this quantity, buyer consideration or assignment price. This is not the valuation of Tibbs or Northway.
The scale factor is not a number of tradable contracts. This example remains one indivisible assumed interest.
Fixed USD 50 fees are a separate assumption. Proportionally scaled reference fees preserve the original arithmetic return and can exceed the approved risk limit.
Assignment consent, real obligations, resources, sale probability and exit prices remain unverified. No observed market outcome calibrates this profile.

source.note: Recorded contrasts can drive hypothetical calculations on a frozen synthetic interest only. Historical initial payments do not establish its quantity, assignment value or fees. This does not change strict research readiness or supply executable land prices.

researchDiagnostics.label: Complete nonempty parsed interviews

researchDiagnostics.label: Human check of scoring judge

researchDiagnostics.label: Three-baseline spread available

limitations: This is a small source-selected liquid-equity event sample, with repeated issuers and correlated events. Numeric comparisons do not establish broad predictive accuracy.
Current-vintage adjusted prices lack historical as-of vintages. Adjusted closes are not literal executable fills; the delayed-close policy is hypothetical.
GLD is a traded gold ETF, not spot gold. Stock-minus-benchmark returns are observed diagnostics, not forecasts or a replicated hedge.
Favourable events alone enter the long-only diagnostic; adverse/mixed events hold cash. Costs are an assumed stress, not measured execution.
The pilot does not estimate Tok option returns, mineral resources, assignment liquidity or incremental swarm value.
This is a bounded, incomplete source sample, not a comprehensive event census.
Nine Pebble events and three Donlin events are heavily concentrated in two issuers.
Procedural admissions, environmental review completion, proposed restrictions and final decisions differ in materiality; direction is a coarse document-effect code.
All timestamps are date-only; several announcements lag actions and may lag first public awareness.
Donlin adverse and mixed rulings were located in later reports but excluded where contemporaneous qualifying publication could not be verified. This can create direction and source-availability bias.
Publication dates identify documented availability, not surprise, investor knowledge, or market reaction.
Issuer and government releases have interested-party framing; direction rationales use procedural effect rather than their promotional claims.
Current-vintage vendor history may contain later corrections; no archived as-of vintage is claimed.
GLD is a traded gold ETF proxy, not spot gold or a Tok mineral-interest price.
Adjusted closes are total-return comparison inputs, not literal executable fill quotes.
No missing price is forward-filled. The hypothetical closing-entry policy assumes access to a closing execution.
Penny-stock prices may have limited vendor precision. Some NAK evaluation windows are flat at the supplied precision; those zeros are not independently verified at finer precision.

evidence.interpretation: Comparison-area screen only; not a deposit probability, legal parcel or resource estimate.

coverage.label: Sample-to-land records
coverage.detail: 33 of 33 area A samples matched to the checked-layer snapshot, including explicit no-match rows. Counts are unique samples, not record pairs.

coverage.label: Mineral title and available interest
coverage.detail: State records and recorded holders do not establish conveyable mineral rights, an available option, assignment consent or liability release. Federal and Native corporation status remain unchecked.

coverage.label: Five-year gold baseline
coverage.detail: Descriptive CAGR of nominal annual gold means from 2020 to 2025. Partial years are excluded. Historical publication dates are unverified. Applying this growth to a hypothetical option is an assumption, not a forecast.

coverage.label: Current commodity quote
coverage.detail: Annual means and the partial 2026 mean are not an executable current gold quote.

coverage.label: Tok mineral-land price baseline
coverage.detail: 10 heterogeneous Alaska deals and statewide surface-sale summaries provide context. Surface medians are not a Tok mineral-price index or a guaranteed value floor.

coverage.label: Holding-cost context
coverage.detail: A dated state-rent schedule is supplied. Current legal applicability, claim age, labour obligations and which party pays remain unverified; no costs are assigned to the option model.

coverage.label: Recoverable resource and success probability
coverage.detail: Sediment assays and land overlaps do not supply recoverable ounces, a geological success probability or a conversion factor.

coverage.label: Available option and executable terms
coverage.detail: No verified available Tok assignment quote, premium, buyer exercise consideration, expiry or capped obligation schedule is supplied.

coverage.label: Assignment liquidity
coverage.detail: Claim counts, surface auctions and mixed project deals do not calibrate a 30/90/180-day option-assignment sale probability.

coverage.label: Point-in-time evaluation data
coverage.detail: Snapshot and retrieval dates are recorded separately. Historical publication times and realized assignment outcomes are not supplied.

limitations: State-claim and state-land snapshots are from 2026; sediment samples were collected in 2016.
Point-in-polygon matches do not establish mineral ownership, recoverable quantities, availability, assignment authority or the sediment source.
Federal BLM status and Native corporation ownership are not checked. Native allotments are a separate checked layer.
Land-status codes and the meaning of NTPSTDT remain unconfirmed.
Nearest-claim distances use an approximate local projection; record boundary uncertainty is unknown.
Source summaries are research evidence, not a current legal opinion or an offer to sell an option.

evidence.interpretation: Comparison-area screen only; not a deposit probability, legal parcel or resource estimate.

coverage.label: Sample-to-land records
coverage.detail: 34 of 34 area B samples matched to the checked-layer snapshot, including explicit no-match rows. Counts are unique samples, not record pairs.

coverage.label: Mineral title and available interest
coverage.detail: State records and recorded holders do not establish conveyable mineral rights, an available option, assignment consent or liability release. Federal and Native corporation status remain unchecked.

coverage.label: Five-year gold baseline
coverage.detail: Descriptive CAGR of nominal annual gold means from 2020 to 2025. Partial years are excluded. Historical publication dates are unverified. Applying this growth to a hypothetical option is an assumption, not a forecast.

coverage.label: Current commodity quote
coverage.detail: Annual means and the partial 2026 mean are not an executable current gold quote.

coverage.label: Tok mineral-land price baseline
coverage.detail: 10 heterogeneous Alaska deals and statewide surface-sale summaries provide context. Surface medians are not a Tok mineral-price index or a guaranteed value floor.

coverage.label: Holding-cost context
coverage.detail: A dated state-rent schedule is supplied. Current legal applicability, claim age, labour obligations and which party pays remain unverified; no costs are assigned to the option model.

coverage.label: Recoverable resource and success probability
coverage.detail: Sediment assays and land overlaps do not supply recoverable ounces, a geological success probability or a conversion factor.

coverage.label: Available option and executable terms
coverage.detail: No verified available Tok assignment quote, premium, buyer exercise consideration, expiry or capped obligation schedule is supplied.

coverage.label: Assignment liquidity
coverage.detail: Claim counts, surface auctions and mixed project deals do not calibrate a 30/90/180-day option-assignment sale probability.

coverage.label: Point-in-time evaluation data
coverage.detail: Snapshot and retrieval dates are recorded separately. Historical publication times and realized assignment outcomes are not supplied.

limitations: State-claim and state-land snapshots are from 2026; sediment samples were collected in 2016.
Point-in-polygon matches do not establish mineral ownership, recoverable quantities, availability, assignment authority or the sediment source.
Federal BLM status and Native corporation ownership are not checked. Native allotments are a separate checked layer.
Land-status codes and the meaning of NTPSTDT remain unconfirmed.
Nearest-claim distances use an approximate local projection; record boundary uncertainty is unknown.
Source summaries are research evidence, not a current legal opinion or an offer to sell an option.

limitations: Two selected historical initial payments from the same acquirer, not a representative current Tok average or an available assignable option.
The reference excludes fees, scholarships, exploration work, recurring payments, royalties and other obligations; it is not full contract capital.
Northway also involved a separate USD 25,000 scholarship and USD 400,000 first-year exploration obligation. These are not included in the initial-payment statistic.
Comparison areas A and B are sample partitions, not legal parcels. No observed assignment resale price or margin is supplied.
Use of the historical payment as a hypothetical option premium does not verify equivalent rights, assignment permission, term or current value.

exposureContext.assumption: One synthetic whole-contract interest retains the invented reference unit economics by scaling both quantity and remaining buyer consideration. The scale is frozen; editing the premium does not change exposure or assignment value.
limitations: The reference unit and its premium-to-exposure ratio are invented arithmetic assumptions, not evidence of mispricing, resources, fair value or attainable returns.
The historical USD 30,000 initial-payment reference does not establish this quantity, buyer consideration or assignment price. This is not the valuation of Tibbs or Northway.
The scale factor is not a number of tradable contracts. This example remains one indivisible assumed interest.
Fixed USD 50 fees are a separate assumption. Proportionally scaled reference fees preserve the original arithmetic return and can exceed the approved risk limit.
Assignment consent, real obligations, resources, sale probability and exit prices remain unverified. No observed market outcome calibrates this profile.

breakEven.constantAssignmentBasis: Equivalent assignment value held constant at every sale date, using the current sale probability and exit fee.

diagnostics.definition: Net cash received by the horizon after all upfront costs. Unsold option marks are excluded. A cash shortfall while an option is held is not necessarily a realized investment loss.

goldForecast.timingAssumption: The retained relative gold-price response is applied once at every valuation and sale date, alongside baseline annual growth. Its size and persistence are assumptions, not estimated market timing.
